display.purpose: Stat count numbers. Must be legible from 1–2 metres.

headline.purpose: Page title only. Wide tracking registers authority.

title.purpose: Stat value text: last-detected time, system status word.

body.purpose: Labels, timestamps, metadata — the working read layer.

label.purpose: Detection class names. Always uppercase, 0.05em tracked.

components.name: Alert Banner
components.description: Fixed full-bleed strip on weapon detection. Auto-dismisses after 3 seconds.
components.css: .ds-alert-banner { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; z-index: 50; animation: ds-pulse 1s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: One of three stats in the grid. Shows a label and a primary value.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.25rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-stat-card__label { color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; } .ds-stat-card__value { font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-stat-card__value--alert { color: #f87171; } .ds-stat-card__value--status-live { color: #4ade80; } .ds-stat-card__value--status-offline { color: #f87171; }

components.name: Detection Row
components.description: A single weapon detection event in the log. Class label left, confidence and timestamp right.
components.css: .ds-detection-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; transition: background 0.15s; list-style: none; } .ds-detection-row:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-detection-row__label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-detection-row__dot { display: block; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ef4444; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-detection-row__class { color: #f87171; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-detection-row__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-detection-row__meta strong { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: 12px dot + text label in the page header. Two states: live and offline.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-status__dot { display: block; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #71717a; } .ds-status--live .ds-status__dot { background: #4ade80; } .ds-status--offline .ds-status__dot { background: #ef4444; } .ds-status__label { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Detection Log Container
components.description: Full-width panel wrapping the detection list. Has a header row and scrollable body.
components.html: Detection Log
components.css: .ds-log { background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-log__header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; } .ds-log__title { font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-log__clear { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #71717a; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0; } .ds-log__clear:hover { color: #d4d4d8; } .ds-log__body { margin: 0; padding: 0; max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; list-style: none; }

narrative.overview:
This interface is built for the operator who cannot look away. Dark, near-black surfaces reduce visual fatigue across extended monitoring sessions. High-contrast white primary text and sharp red alert signals cut through without competing for attention. The system speaks only when it must — the absence of decoration is the design; every element that remains is load-bearing.

The palette is strictly functional: neutral grays hold structure, red owns threat signals, and green holds exactly one meaning: the system is live. No color appears for decoration. The layout is generous enough to scan at a glance from across a room, but dense enough to fit meaningful data without scrolling under normal conditions.

Geist Sans carries the typographic system — geometric, legible at small sizes, with zero personality flourish.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layering with no shadows
Red as the exclusive signal color for threats and alerts
Green reserved for a single state: system live
Uppercase tracking on detection class labels
Rounded-xl containers; full-pill only for status indicators

rules.name: The Red Monopoly Rule
rules.body: Red means weapon. It appears on detection labels, detection dots, the alert banner, and the disconnected state. No other element borrows it. If you're tempted to use red for a non-threat purpose, use gray instead.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only two colors carry live semantic meaning: red (threat / disconnected) and green (live). Every other element is neutral. Adding a third signal color breaks the read.

rules.name: The Label Register Rule
rules.body: Detection class names are always uppercase, medium weight, 0.05em tracked. They must read like a classification, not a word.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows. If you need to indicate a new layer, raise the background one step toward white. If you need to indicate action, raise it on hover. Shadows introduce visual noise that competes with alert signals.

dos: Do use rounded-xl (0.75rem) for all panel and card surfaces.
Do keep all detection-related text in alert (#f87171) or stronger — never muted or secondary gray.
Do use uppercase with tracking-[0.05em] for detection class labels.
Do pair every audio alert with a visual one (and vice versa) so the operator is not dependent on a single channel.
Do reserve green (status-live) exclusively for the system-live connection state.
donts: Don't add box-shadows. Depth is tonal only.
Don't use red for anything other than weapon detections, disconnect state, and the alert banner.
Don't introduce a third semantic signal color. The two-signal system (red / green) must stay unambiguous.
Don't wrap static metadata (timestamps, confidence scores) in pill containers — they are plain text with appropriate color weight.
Don't use backdrop-filter or blur effects. The system has no glassmorphic surfaces.
